title: MCPRuntime autoload enabled unconditionally — unauthenticated TCP control server on all interfaces, no debug gate
evidence:
project.godot (added by this diff):
+[autoload]
+
+MCPRuntime="*uid://1nrmjgkqqhm0"

mcp_runtime_autoload.gd (verified behavior, no gate):
func _ready() -> void:
	name = "MCPRuntime"
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_start_server()
func _start_server() -> void:
	_server = TCPServer.new()
	var error = _server.listen(_port)        # no bind address -> 0.0.0.0:7777
control surface over the socket: "set_property", "call_method", "inject_action", "inject_key", "capture_screenshot"
detail: Added unconditionally; MCPRuntime opens an unauthenticated TCPServer on 0.0.0.0:7777 with no is_debug_build gate. Any LAN client can call_method/set_property/inject_input/capture the screen. Canon §7.6 requires debug tools be release-gated.
recommended_fix: Gate MCPRuntime behind OS.is_debug_build() or exclude it from the release export preset (architecture §7.6). At minimum bind TCPServer to '127.0.0.1' and require auth.
